  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pickup command reverts the catch-up wake mechanism, so remaining queue items are not scheduled for automated draining between hourly wakes.
  WHY: Without `send_later`, queue items remaining after a wake wait until the next hourly routine; the preflight check also no longer verifies `send_later`, and the existing contract tests will fail.
- .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md:Step 3a.1 and 3a.2 (lines 60-61 of the post-PR file) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The pickup does not persist the pagination cursor between wakes, so it repeatedly scans the newest 10 pages and never examines older sessions when the 14-day window exceeds 1,000 sessions.
  WHY: `next_after_id()` returns `None` at the page cap even when more pages exist, and the pickup starts each hourly wake without an `after_id`; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2 considered the cap intentional rather than a defect.
- .claude/scripts/stale_sessions.py:`next_after_id()` (`--max-pages` check) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Reaching the 10-page limit returns no continuation cursor, and the pickup does not persist a cursor between hourly wakes.
  WHY: If the 14-day window spans more than 10 pages, sessions beyond the first 1,000 are never examined; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2 considered the cap intentional rather than a defect.
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:Step 2, the `open` bullet ("`open` → nothing is due. If you are a fresh session, make sure the PR has a §26 check-in (step 7). Report and end the turn.") | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `open` early-end branch does not explicitly instruct the fixer to invoke the step 8 permission prompt report before ending.
  WHY: An unattended fixer taking this path can end without filing its permission-prompt record, and the test only checks for the substring `report` in the branch wording.

- .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md:lines 18-20, 48-50, 66, 88-91 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md was modified against a stale baseline ref that predates PR #4990, reverting the catch-up wake mechanism introduced by that change. The diff removes send_later from preflight tools and tool access, reverts step 2 remaining entries to "at most 10 are started per wake" while discarding QUEUE_PICKUP_LIMIT (20) and oldest_waiting_minutes / catch_up_due, reverts step 4 from "Catch-up, then report" to plain "Report" (deleting the 30-minute catch-up wake scheduling via send_later), and strips oldest_waiting and catch_up tokens from the report string.
  WHY: When queue items remain after an hourly wake, the pickup will not schedule a 30-minute catch-up wake via send_later, disabling automated queue draining between hourly routines; the command preflight check no longer verifies the presence of send_later; existing contract tests in tests/test_implement_issue_claude_command.py (test_pickup_schedules_one_self_bound_catch_up_wake and test_pickup_reports_queue_age_limit_and_resume_order) assert the presence of send_later, Catch-up wake, oldest_waiting_minutes, and catch_up in .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md, and will fail when evaluated against this modified command file.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- `.claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md`:Step 3a.1 and 3a.2 (lines 60-61 of the post-PR file); the surrounding "Stay lean" rule | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The 10-page-per-wake cap in `stale_sessions.py::next_after_id()` returns `None` once `pages >= max_pages` even when `has_more` is still true, and the pickup procedure has no provision to persist the `next_after_id` between wakes.
  WHY: Each wake starts listing from the newest session page, so the same newest 10 pages (1,000 sessions) are re-scanned every hour while the 11th page and beyond are never examined; if the steady-state volume exceeds 1,000 sessions within the 14-day horizon, the older pages are never reached and accumulate forever. The design may be intentional at low volume, but the cursor returned by the script is discarded at wake boundaries, masking under-archive growth as session creation outpaces the janitor.
- `.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md`:Step 2, the `open` bullet ("`open` → nothing is due. If you are a fresh session, make sure the PR has a §26 check-in (step 7). Report and end the turn.") | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `open` early-end branch does not explicitly instruct the fixer to invoke `permission_prompts.py file --session-label <id>` before ending the turn.
  WHY: An unattended fixer taking this path can end without filing the session's permission-prompt record; the test only asserts the substring `report` is present in each branch line, so the wording can pass the test without instructing the model to run the report.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
